identity.en: A tall Chinese woman of about thirty-two, present-day urban China, the night-duty lobby manager of a commercial property
identity.text: 约三十二岁的物业夜班大堂经理，当代中国都市

face.en: A clean jawline, level calm brows, clear unhurried eyes that read documents and people with the same flat attention, very light makeup
face.text: 下颌线干净，眉平而稳，一双不慌不忙的眼睛，妆极淡

hair.en: Black hair pinned into a low practical bun with the side strands tucked behind the ears
hair.text: 黑发挽成利落的低发髻，侧边碎发别到耳后

build.en: Straight capable posture with square set shoulders, tall and steady on her feet
build.text: 站姿利落，方肩直背，身量高挑，站得稳

skin.en: Neat, well-kept skin with very light makeup and no visible blemish
skin.text: 皮肤收拾得干净，妆极淡，无明显瑕疵

top.en: a dark navy property-management uniform jacket with neat shoulder tabs over a crisp white shirt, a walkie-talkie clipped at the left chest, and a ballpoint pen clipped inside the jacket placket
top.text: 深藏青物业制服外套带肩袢，内搭挺括白衬衫，左胸别对讲机，门襟别圆珠笔

bottom.en: matching dark navy uniform trousers and clean low-heeled shoes
bottom.text: 同色制服裤与干净的平跟皮鞋

details.en: a walkie-talkie clipped at the left chest of a navy uniform jacket, antenna short and neat
details.text: 别在左胸的对讲机，天线短而整齐

details.en: the crisp white shirt collar under an open navy uniform jacket collar
details.text: 白衬衫领口，外套领敞开

details.en: the dark navy uniform cuff, pressed flat and neat at the wrist
details.text: 挺括压平的藏青制服袖口

details.en: clean low-heeled dark uniform shoes, toes polished from the night shift
details.text: 干净的深色平跟制服皮鞋

look.style: A real photograph, not a render: shot on a full-frame digital camera with an 85mm portrait lens at f/5.6, natural true-to-life colors and white balance. Natural skin texture with the pores and fine lines the person's age calls for, a no-makeup look, no retouching, no beauty filter. Real fabric with natural creases. Subtle film grain.
look.clean: White seamless paper backdrop lit to pure white. A soft directional key light from the front-left with a weaker fill, so the face and clothes have gentle natural shadows and volume. Exactly one person, empty hands, no props, no text, no watermark.
look.neg: CGI, 3D render, digital painting, illustration, anime, airbrushed skin, smooth plastic skin, waxy skin, doll face, beauty filter, overly symmetrical face, oversharpened, HDR, glossy, over-saturated, flat lighting, porcelain skin, big anime eyes
